tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Answer whether a specific red dot optic fits a specific pistol, from source-cited data. Returns fit "direct" (mounts on the slide cut, with the footprint), "adapter" (only through the adapter plate chain in via, with plate maker, model, mount and presented footprints, and plate sources), or "unknown

tools.name: list_optics_for_pistol
tools.description: List every optic with a cited fit on one pistol, each marked direct (with footprint) or adapter (with the plate chain in via). Use it for questions like "what red dots fit my pistol". Optics not listed have no cited fit, which is not evidence they do not fit. Report the answer exactly as returned: n

tools.name: list_pistols_for_optic
tools.description: List every pistol with a cited fit for one optic, each marked direct (with footprint) or adapter (with the plate chain in via). Use it for questions like "what pistols take this red dot". Report the answer exactly as returned: never call an adapter fit a direct fit, and never turn "unknown" into "do

tools.name: get_footprint
tools.description: Describe one optic mounting footprint or plate system (for example RMR, RMSc, ACRO, DPP, Glock MOS): screw and recoil lug counts, the optics that use it, the pistols cut for it directly, and the adapter plates that mount or present it, with sources.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find pistols, optics and footprints by name. Returns slugs, names and page URLs to pass to the other tools. Use it when you are unsure of an exact model name.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
